lines.text: This is the story of Sam, and a little pawn named Pip.
Sam was playing the computer. Its rook moved, and Pip spotted danger.
But Sam jumped the knight forward. Oh no! A pawn could take it.
Pip asked Stockfish to check the move.
Then Pip's small AI turned the facts into kind words.
Sam tried again, and Pip gave hints.
Rook to e1! The pawn was safe.
After the game, they looked back together.
And every game, Sam got a little better.
